cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)
project(answer VERSION 1.0.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)
include(GNUInstallDirs)
find_package(ZLIB REQUIRED)
find_package(Iconv REQUIRED)
add_library(answer_shared SHARED answer.c)
add_library(answer_static STATIC answer.c)
target_link_libraries(answer_shared PRIVATE ZLIB::ZLIB Iconv::Iconv)
target_link_libraries(answer_static PRIVATE ZLIB::ZLIB Iconv::Iconv)
add_executable(answer main.cc)
target_link_libraries(answer PRIVATE answer_shared)
add_executable(answer_static_test main.cc)
target_link_libraries(answer_static_test PRIVATE answer_static)
set_target_properties(answer PROPERTIES INSTALL_RPATH "${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/lib")
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME shared COMMAND answer)
add_test(NAME static COMMAND answer_static_test)
set_tests_properties(shared static PROPERTIES PASS_REGULAR_EXPRESSION "42")
install(TARGETS answer answer_shared answer_static RUNTIME DESTINATION bin LIBRARY DESTINATION lib ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib)
set(CPACK_PACKAGE_VERSION ${PROJECT_VERSION})
include(CPack)
